US warns citizens to leave West Asia amid Iran tensions

The United States issued advisories urging its citizens to consider departing from West Asia due to escalating tensions with Iran. The messages advised checking flight details and following local safety advice. President Trump threatened to hit Iran "very hard," while Iran warned of retaliation targeting oil and gas facilities in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Qatar if struck by the US. Exxon and Chevron warned of continued high fuel prices if a conflict occurs. Kuwait reported drone attacks, and Israel launched strikes on Gaza.
